title: pinneapple_train example 02: DataModule + robust preprocessing
description: pinneapple_train example 02: DataModule + robust preprocessing. What this shows -------------- - Building loaders with pinneapple_train.DataModule (train/val/test split). - Leakage-safe *time* split (no shuffle across the time axis). - A preprocessing pipeline that: - fills missing values (NaNs) - normalizes inputs using statistics fitted on *train batches only* - Training with Trainer + audit log
